title: Workflow (Simplified Input)
description: Lightweight container for an ordered sequence of process step IRIs. Each step must already be recorded independently using an x-process-step schema (tensile test, simulation, sample preparation, etc.). This schema provides the human-readable envelope and provenance context.

label.title: Workflow Name
label.description: Human-readable name for this workflow or experiment. Example: 'QA-to-FEM material card workflow — 316L batch 1'.

id.title: Workflow ID
id.description: Optional. IRI slug for the workflow node. Auto-derived from label if omitted.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description of the workflow goal and context.

responsible.title: Responsible Person
responsible.description: Optional. IRI of the person accountable for this workflow.

steps.title: Process Steps
steps.description: Ordered list of process step IRIs that make up this workflow. Each IRI must resolve to an instance recorded with an x-process-step schema. The order reflects the intended execution sequence.
